_readme: A Room of One's Own — sourced from gutenberg.ca (Woolf died 1941; PD in Canada since 1991, and PD in the US as of 2025 under the 95-year rule since it was published 1929).

books.title: A Room of One's Own
books.author: Virginia Woolf
books.synopsis: Invited to lecture on women and fiction, Woolf argues that a woman needs money and a room of her own to write at all, tracing the silencing of women's genius from Shakespeare's imagined sister to the present.
